summary: If you're a fresh grad/getting into the industry, this is a fun opportunity. If not, consider wisely.
pros:
- Good colleagues and leaders (but it very much depends on your luck because some teams have it worse)
- Medical benefits, optical and dental claims, gym subsidies
- Workload varies across different teams. If you're up for challenges you will enjoy being in a team with heavy workload and strict SOPs, that's how you seek fun in a repetitive job. Some teams have super easy jobs, but will be repetitive and boring.
- Care about employees' mental health, loads of fun activities for you to attend.
- Salary is okay, with language allowances and/or shift allowances.
cons:
- Management is very stingy, will cut benefits/KPIs/employees' fund to spare budget for other stuff.
- BPO companies are overall volatile, be prepared that your team will ramp down suddenly or get transferred to other projects with short notice.
- Promotion is sometimes unfair, candidates with good connection with upper management have a better chance of getting chosen.
- Too many systems with basically similar functions, could've merged them into one.
- Little to no increment or bonus.
